context: Teacher and student discuss election results — Diet seats and political knowledge
purpose: Teach: 議席/議員/公務/議論/軍/命/知識/行動

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮くん、昨日の選挙のニュース見た？与党が議席を大きく減らしたわね。
lines.en: Ren, did you see yesterday's election news? The ruling party lost a lot of seats.
lines.style: Warm teacher opening a current-events discussion gently

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 見ました。国会議員の顔ぶれもかなり変わりそうですね。
lines.en: I did. The lineup of Diet members is going to change quite a bit too.
lines.style: Engaged university student responding thoughtfully and politely

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そう。でも正直に言うと、若い人たちの政治の知識がもう少し深まればと思うの。
lines.en: Right. But honestly, I wish young people would deepen their political knowledge a bit more.
lines.style: Teacher voicing a candid, slightly concerned opinion

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 確かに。僕もゼミで議論することはあっても、実際の行動には繋がっていない気がします。
lines.en: True. Even though we debate in seminars, I don't feel it leads to real action.
lines.style: Self-reflective student admitting his own shortcomings honestly

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 公務員を目指す学生さんも多いでしょう？投票はその第一歩よ。
lines.en: Many students aim to become civil servants, right? Voting is the first step.
lines.style: Encouraging mentor connecting careers to civic duty

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。特に防衛費や軍事に関わる政策は、一票が誰かの命に関わることもありますしね。
lines.en: Yes. Especially with defense spending and military policy, a single vote can affect lives.
lines.style: Serious student elevating the stakes of voting maturely

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いい視点ね。そういう感覚を持って活発な議論ができる若者が増えれば、社会は変わるわ。
lines.en: Great perspective. If more young people debated actively with that awareness, society would change.
lines.style: Teacher affirming her student with quiet enthusiasm and hope

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 次の選挙までに、もっと自分なりに勉強して友達とも話してみます。
lines.en: Before the next election, I'll study more on my own and talk with my friends.
lines.style: Determined student making a sincere personal commitment forward
